summary: The core tap-to-bake and upgrade loop was clear, allowing the player to progress from Sweet Corner to Bakery Lane. However, a slow initial start, a small target for the Golden Cupcake, and an overly demanding Rush Order target caused repeated failures.

items.title: Rush Order target (25 cakes in 10s) is too difficult
items.evidence: The player activated Golden Frenzy x3 but only reached 11/25 cakes before the 'ORDER MISSED!' fail screen appeared at t=31.4s. After tapping 'Try Again', they only reached 12/25 cakes with 1s left at t=41.8s.
items.suggestion: Reduce the Rush Order requirement from 25 cakes to 12-15 cakes in 10s (or extend the timer to 15s) so casual players can complete the order and experience the reward.

items.title: Slow time to first tap due to lack of initial motion
items.evidence: Despite the 'Tap the cake to bake!' tutorial, there was 3.5s of idle time with no on-screen motion, and it took 5.4s for the first tap to register.
items.suggestion: Add an animated, pulsing hand pointer directly over the center cake from t=0.0s along with a subtle idle bounce on the cake to prompt immediate interaction.

items.title: Imprecise taps when trying to hit the Golden Cupcake
items.evidence: Two imprecise tap slips were recorded at t=25.9s, right as the player was trying to activate the floating Golden Cupcake x3.
items.suggestion: Increase the invisible hit-box of the floating Golden Cupcake by 30-50% and slow its travel speed slightly so it is easier to tap during active gameplay.

signals.detail: 5.4 s from the first playable frame until an input visibly worked
3.5 s with no on-screen motion and no input
2 imprecise tap(s) by the player (targets may be small)
end card appeared at 44.2 s (session 49.1 s)
